source_evidence: Sales commissions and upfront offering fees usually total approximately 9 to 10 percent of the investment.
answer: REIT fees can differ by type. When purchasing a publicly traded REIT through a broker, brokerage fees apply. Non-traded REITs typically have high upfront costs: sales commissions and offering fees usually add up to about 9–10% of the investment, reducing its value by a significant amount. Consider these costs when comparing REITs.
